label: an approximate reconstruction from the cited claims, not the experiment's geometry
subsystem: endcap muon system, cathode strip chambers of both endcaps (LHC start-up configuration)

quantities.name: chambers
quantities.definition: cathode strip chambers in the expanded IR (both endcaps)
quantities.derivation: 72 ME1/1 + 72 ME1/2 + 72 ME1/3 + 36 ME2/1 + 72 ME2/2 + 36 ME3/1 + 72 ME3/2 + 36 ME4/1 (detector-atlas:C142, 2008); per endcap 36 per 10-degree ring and 18 per 20-degree ring (C147, 2010): 2 x (5 x 36 + 3 x 18) = 468

independence.result: a design count stated by the 2008 detector paper and, ring by ring, by the 2010 CSC paper; not a simulation output; it checks the ring placements

negative_control.change: one ME4/1 chamber fewer in each endcap

quantities.name: gas_gaps
quantities.definition: gas gaps (sensitive layers) in the expanded IR, both endcaps
quantities.derivation: 468 chambers (detector-atlas:C142) x 6 gas gaps between 7 cathode panels, one anode wire plane each (C143)

independence.result: design counts from the 2008 detector paper, not a simulation output

negative_control.change: ME2/2 and ME3/2 chambers (one template, 144 chambers) with 5 gas gaps

approximations: chambers are trd envelopes with the 1997 TDR outer length and top and bottom widths (C148, design; the ME1/1 row belongs to a superseded ME1/1 design); the as-built dimensions are not confirmed by a read source

inside a chamber only the 6 gas gaps (9.5 mm, 7 mm in ME1/1; C143, C144) at the anode-plane separation of 25.4 mm (22 mm in ME1/1; C146) are modelled; the cathode panels (16.2 mm, C143), strips, wires, frames and electronics are not, and the chamber thickness is 6 x the separation

station z positions and ring radii are not sourced (figure labels unreadable): each ring sits on its own planes 200 mm apart, alternate chambers of a ring on two planes so that neighbours do not intersect, with the trapezoid's apex on the beam line; the two endcaps are translated copies 12 m apart
gas density from the ideal-gas law at 293.15 K and 101325 Pa (not sourced); the count does not depend on it
ME4/2 (installed after the 2008 description) is not included
status: comparison with cited values: not validated
